You can spend "Blood points" to activate effects from the "Blood Tithe" table during the activation of each of your units. You gain a number of Blood points during each Command phase equal to the current battle round. Additionally, you gain +1 Blood point each time a unit loses its last Wound (friendly and enemy alike). Multiple Blood points can be spend at the same time and powers can be used multiple times per battle round. Remaining Blood points are lost after the last activation of each battle round.
The target unit gains the "Furious Charge" ability.

The target unit heals 3 Wounds +1 Wound for each additional Blood point spent on it. Dead models may be revived with this ability. Injured models have to be fully healed first.
